sentences.en: We are losing our listening. We spend roughly 60 percent of our communication time listening, but we're not very good at it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在丧失倾听的能力我们交流过程中60%的时间都是用来倾听但其实我们并不擅长倾听

sentences.en: We retain just 25 percent of what we hear.
sentences.zh: 我们只保留了25%所听到的内容

sentences.en: Now -- not you, not this talk, but that is generally true.
sentences.zh: 不是指在座各位和这个演讲这是一个普遍的事实让我们来定义倾听

sentences.en: (Laughter) Let's define listening as making meaning from sound.
sentences.zh: 就是使得声音有意义

sentences.en: It's a mental process, and it's a process of extraction.
sentences.zh: 这是一个心理过程它也是一个提取的过程我们用一些很酷的技术完成这个过程

sentences.en: We use some pretty cool techniques to do this.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是模式识别技术

sentences.en: One of them is pattern recognition. (Crowd noises) So in a cocktail party like this, if I say, "David, Sara, pay attention" -- some of you just sat up.
sentences.zh: （人群噪音）在像这样的一个鸡尾酒会上如果我说 “大卫，莎拉，注意了”你们中间就会有人坐直身子

sentences.en: We recognize patterns to distinguish noise from signal, and especially our name.
sentences.zh: 我们能识别出一些声音特点从而从信号中区分它们特别是对于自己的名字

sentences.en: Differencing is another technique we use.
sentences.zh: 区分是我们用的另外一个技术

sentences.en: If I left this pink noise on for more than a couple of minutes, (Pink noise) you would literally cease to hear it.
sentences.zh: 如果我让这种粉红噪声保持几分钟你就不会很认真的听它了我们只会听有变化声音

sentences.en: We listen to differences; we discount sounds that remain the same.
sentences.zh: 我们不大专注于持续不变的声音

sentences.en: And then there is a whole range of filters.
sentences.zh: 这里有一系列的过滤功能

sentences.en: These filters take us from all sound down to what we pay attention to.
sentences.zh: 它把我们从所有声音中抽离出来重点去听我们所关注的

sentences.en: Most people are entirely unconscious of these filters.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都完全没有察觉这些过滤器

sentences.en: But they actually create our reality in a way, because they tell us what we're paying attention to right now.
sentences.zh: 但是它们在某种程度上创造了现实生活因为它们告诉我们当下我们正在关注什么

sentences.en: I'll give you one example of that. Intention is very important in sound, in listening.
sentences.zh: 举个例子：意向在声音和听觉中非常重要

sentences.en: When I married my wife, I promised her I would listen to her every day as if for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我娶我夫人的时候我向她承诺我每天都会像我们第一次见面那样去倾听她

sentences.en: Now that's something I fall short of on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 现在我每天都在下降（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) But it's a great intention to have in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 但这是这种关系下的一个很好的意愿但这不是全部

sentences.en: (Laughter) But that's not all. Sound places us in space and in time.
sentences.zh: 声音把我们置于时间和空间中

sentences.en: If you close your eyes right now in this room, you're aware of the size of the room from the reverberation and the bouncing of the sound off the surfaces; you're aware of how many people are around you, because of the micro-noises you're receiving.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在马上闭上眼你会通过声音回响以及声音在物体表面撞击的力度感觉出这件房间的大小你还可以感觉到在你周围有多少人因为你可以听到周围微小的噪音

sentences.en: And sound places us in time as well, because sound always has time embedded in it.
sentences.zh: 同时，声音还把我们置于时间中因为声音总是和时间并存的

sentences.en: In fact, I would suggest that our listening is the main way that we experience the flow of time from past to future.
sentences.zh: 实际上我认为听觉是我们最主要的方式去感受时间从过去到未来的流动因此 “声音是时间和存在”--很好的引述

sentences.en: So, "Sonority is time and meaning" -- a great quote.
sentences.zh: 我在演讲开始的时候说过，我们正逐渐丧失倾听的能力

sentences.en: I said at the beginning, we're losing our listening.
sentences.zh: 我为什么这么说呢？

sentences.en: Why did I say that? Well, there are a lot of reasons for this.
sentences.zh: 这里面有许多的原因首先，我们发明了记录的方式--

sentences.en: First of all, we invented ways of recording -- first writing, then audio recording and now video recording as well.
sentences.zh: 一开始通过书写，接着是录音然后到了现在可以记录影像

sentences.en: The premium on accurate and careful listening has simply disappeared.
sentences.zh: 精确、仔细的倾听所带来的好处已经消失了

sentences.en: Secondly, the world is now so noisy, (Noise) with this cacophony going on visually and auditorily, it's just hard to listen; it's tiring to listen.
sentences.zh: 第二，现在的世界太嘈杂了（噪音）伴随着视觉、听觉上的这样的污染已经很难去倾听了也疲于去倾听了

sentences.en: Many people take refuge in headphones, but they turn big, public spaces like this, shared soundscapes, into millions of tiny, little personal sound bubbles.
sentences.zh: 许多人用耳机逃避吵杂的世界但是他们把像这样的庞大的，公共空间本可被共享的音乐场景变成了数百万个这样的私人音乐小气泡

sentences.en: In this scenario, nobody's listening to anybody.
sentences.zh: 这种情况下，没有人会倾听其他人我们正在变得浮躁

sentences.en: We're becoming impatient. We don't want oratory anymore; we want sound bites.
sentences.zh: 我们更青睐简单的语言而不再需要那些华丽的词藻

sentences.en: And the art of conversation is being replaced -- dangerously, I think -- by personal broadcasting.
sentences.zh: 交谈的艺术正在被私人化的平实语言所取代我认为这是很危险的

sentences.en: I don't know how much listening there is in this conversation, which is sadly very common, especially in the UK.
sentences.zh: 我不清楚这种交谈中倾听能够占几成通常都很不乐观特别是在英国

sentences.en: We're becoming desensitized. Our media have to scream at us with these kinds of headlines in order to get our attention.
sentences.zh: 我们正在变得麻木媒体不得不用这样的标题向我们“嘶吼”就是为了夺人眼球

sentences.en: And that means it's harder for us to pay attention to the quiet, the subtle, the understated.
sentences.zh: 这就意味着我们难以专注于安静的，细微的需要理解的东西

sentences.en: This is a serious problem that we're losing our listening.
sentences.zh: 丧失倾听的能力是个很严重的问题

sentences.en: This is not trivial, because listening is our access to understanding.
sentences.zh: 这不是没有意义的因为倾听是我们去认识事物的途径

sentences.en: Conscious listening always creates understanding, and only without conscious listening can these things happen.
sentences.zh: 有意识的去倾听往往有助于我们的理解力如果失去有意识的倾听就会导致以下的后果--

sentences.en: A world where we don't listen to each other at all is a very scary place indeed.
sentences.zh: 一个人们不会相互倾听的世界是非常可怕的

sentences.en: So I'd like to share with you five simple exercises, tools you can take away with you, to improve your own conscious listening.
sentences.zh: 因此 我希望与大家分享五个简单的技巧来帮助大家改进自己有意识的倾听你们想听吗？

sentences.en: Would you like that? Audience: Yes! Good. The first one is silence.
sentences.zh: （听众：当然） 好！首先是安静

sentences.en: Just three minutes a day of silence is a wonderful exercise to reset your ears and to recalibrate, so that you can hear the quiet again.
sentences.zh: 每天只需拿出三分钟让自己安静下来就是一个很好的练习来让听觉系统进行重置和调整从而可以再一次感受到宁静

sentences.en: If you can't get absolute silence, go for quiet, that's absolutely fine.
sentences.zh: 如果没有完全无声的环境那就去一个安静的地方也没问题

sentences.en: Second, I call this "the mixer." (Noise) So even if you're in a noisy environment like this -- and we all spend a lot of time in places like this -- listen in the coffee bar to how many channels of sound can I hear?
sentences.zh: 第二点，我称之为混合器（噪音）即使你在一个像这样嘈杂的环境中--我们很多时间都生活在这样的环境中--在咖啡厅里听你可以听到多少种声音？

sentences.en: How many individual channels in that mix am I listening to?
sentences.zh: 你可以在混杂噪音中分辨出多少独立的声音？

sentences.en: You can do it in a beautiful place as well, like in a lake.
sentences.zh: 这种方法也可以在幽静的地方练习，比如在湖边

sentences.en: How many birds am I hearing? Where are they? Where are those ripples?
sentences.zh: 我可以听到多少种鸟叫声？它们从哪里发出？传向哪里？这也是很好的练习

sentences.en: It's a great exercise for improving the quality of your listening.
sentences.zh: 来改善我们的听觉能力第三点，我称之为品味声音

sentences.en: Third, this exercise I call "savoring," and this is a beautiful exercise.
sentences.zh: 这是个很好的练习

sentences.en: It's about enjoying mundane sounds. This, for example, is my tumble dryer.
sentences.zh: 是关于享受平淡声音的比如说，这是我的滚筒式干衣机

sentences.en: (Dryer) It's a waltz -- one, two, three; one, two, three; one, two, three.
I love it! Or just try this one on for size.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它或者试试这个

sentences.en: (Coffee grinder) Wow! So, mundane sounds can be really interesting --
sentences.zh: （咖啡研磨机）哇喔！如果你用心，如此平凡的声音也可以这样有趣

sentences.en: if you pay attention. I call that the "hidden choir" -- it's around us all the time.
sentences.zh: 我称其为隐形合唱团他们一直都在我们周围下一个练习

sentences.en: The next exercise is probably the most important of all of these, if you just take one thing away.
sentences.zh: 也许是五项之中最重要的如果只选一个的话

sentences.en: This is listening positions -- the idea that you can move your listening position to what's appropriate to what you're listening to.
sentences.zh: 那就是倾听的状态--你可以改变你倾听的状态根据你所听的内容而定这些要用到哪些过滤器

sentences.en: This is playing with those filters. Remember I gave you those filters?
sentences.zh: 还记得吗，我开始的时候提到过的

sentences.en: It's starting to play with them as levers, to get conscious about them and to move to different places.
sentences.zh: 像一个杠杆一样去运用它们根据它们来移动到不同的地方屏幕上只是一部分倾听的状态

sentences.en: These are just some of the listening positions, or scales of listening positions, that you can use.
sentences.zh: 或者是大家可以运用的倾听状态的一些尺度

sentences.en: There are many. Have fun with that. It's very exciting.
sentences.zh: 还有许多它很有趣，很让人激动

sentences.en: And finally, an acronym. You can use this in listening, in communication.
sentences.zh: 最后，是一个缩略词你可以在倾听、交流时用到它

sentences.en: If you're in any one of those roles -- and I think that probably is everybody who's listening to this talk -- the acronym is RASA, which is the Sanskrit word for "juice" or "essence."
sentences.zh: 只要你处于其中一种情况下--我想可能听这个演讲的在座各位都是吧--这个缩写就是RASA它本身是个梵文意思是汁液或者精华

sentences.en: And RASA stands for "Receive," which means pay attention to the person; "Appreciate," making little noises like "hmm," "oh," "OK"; "Summarize" -- the word "so" is very important in communication; and "Ask," ask questions afterwards.
sentences.zh: 同时RASA这里代表着 接受意思是关注于与你交谈的人赏识，做出些反映比如，恩，哦，好不错；小结 “所以，因此”这个词在交流中是非常重要的以及 询问 最后的时候问些问题

sentences.en: Now sound is my passion, it's my life. I wrote a whole book about it. So I live to listen.
sentences.zh: 声音是我的爱好 我的生命我为此写了一本书，所以我为倾听而生

sentences.en: That's too much to ask for most people. But I believe that every human being needs to listen consciously in order to live fully -- connected in space and in time to the physical world around us,
sentences.zh: 当然这对大多数人来说要求太高了但是我相信每一个人都需要有意识的倾听才是完整的生活--把空间和时间和我们周围的自然世界联系起来

sentences.en: connected in understanding to each other, not to mention spiritually connected, because every spiritual path I know of has listening and contemplation at its heart.
sentences.zh: 把每个人用相互理解联系起来更不用说是精神层面的联系因为每一个我了解的精神幽径都包括发自内心的倾听和凝视这就是为什么

sentences.en: That's why we need to teach listening in our schools as a skill.
sentences.zh: 我们需要在学校把倾听当作一个技能去传授

sentences.en: Why is it not taught? It's crazy. And if we can teach listening in our schools, we can take our listening off that slippery slope to that dangerous, scary world that I talked about, and move it to a place where everybody is consciously listening all the time,
sentences.zh: 为什么实际情况却相反？太不可理解了如果我们可以在学校里传授倾听技巧可以阻止我们的听觉坠向我提到过的那个危险、可怕的世界并将其引导到一个每个人都乐于有意识的去倾听的地方--

sentences.en: or at least capable of doing it. Now, I don't know how to do that, but this is TED, and I think the TED community is capable of anything.
sentences.zh: 或者至少有能力去倾听现在还不知道如何做到这点但这就是TED我认为TED团体有能力做任何事情

sentences.en: So I invite you to connect with me, connect with each other, take this mission out.
sentences.zh: 因此我邀请大家联系我，同时彼此互相联系秉承这个使命，同时让倾听课程进入学校

sentences.en: And let's get listening taught in schools, and transform the world in one generation to a conscious, listening world -- a world of connection, a world of understanding and a world of peace.
sentences.zh: 通过一代人的努力把世界变成一个乐于倾听的世界--一个彼此联系的世界一个相互理解的世界 一个和平的世界

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to me today. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家今天倾听我的演讲（掌声）
